text: On launch, Chromium 'Page Unresponsive' dialog over the loading screen (Loading 1.0 of 1.0 MB) while state says TITLE. Clicked Wait.

Triangle visually nearly closed from x=-10.1,z=3.8 (beam ends overlap, crosshair ring glowing faintly) but not accepted; timed hint then says the ring of light is near the door. The tone cue cannot be relied on; the crosshair ring glow is subtle.

Triangle solved at tick 46812 (~13 min game time incl. long wandering). The closing spot ring sits beside the bench in the corner, which I would not call 'near the door you came in'; with default pitch the floor ring is out of view and only shows if you tilt down. Visual 'almost closed' views 1-2 m away were not accepted, and there was no visible feedback of getting closer besides a faint crosshair ring.

Balcony board body text (the counting-I's argument) is tiny and hard to read even standing on the balcony ~2 m away at an angle; the headline and the 'MU can't be made' sign are readable but the explanation is not, the board is mounted on a side wall so you can only see it obliquely.
